authority.user_authorization: Start World Model V2 using only new unseen data; do not open B05.

v1_viewed_panels: FA Women's Super League 2018/2019, 2019/2020, 2020/2021, 2023/2024 development panel
successor_boundary.forbidden_for_v2_selection_or_tuning: No V0/V1 test metric, residual, fixture outcome, per-match error, threshold failure, draw-calibration bin, or viewed label may be used to tune V2 parameters or gates.
successor_boundary.structural_rationale: V2 isolates whether explicit home-away score dependence improves the joint 90-minute score distribution while holding pre-match marginal scoring intensities fixed to the frozen baseline family.

estimand: Holding chronologically available pre-match marginal goal intensities fixed, can a low-capacity bivariate-Poisson shared-score component improve the full 90-minute joint score distribution over independent Poisson on a completely new development panel?

development_panel.selection_basis: Competition/season existence only from competitions.json before opening match metadata or target outcomes.
development_panel.coverage_failure_policy: STOP_DATA_COVERAGE. Do not lower thresholds and do not automatically switch to another panel after match metadata becomes viewed.

reserved_confirmation_panel.hard_rule: Do not open match payloads, events, labels, counts derived from match payloads, or model metrics from this panel during V2 development. A development PASS still does not authorize opening this reserve automatically.

time_ordering.panel_order: global chronological match_date across the two NWSL seasons
time_ordering.same_day_policy: All fixtures on a calendar date are predicted before any outcomes from that date update history.
time_ordering.split: First chronological 45% is burn-in/training-only; remaining dates form the untouched development test.
time_ordering.folding: Three contiguous chronological date-group folds by match count; never split a calendar date across folds.

baseline.name: rolling_xg_independent_poisson
baseline.joint_distribution: independent Poisson home and away goals

candidate.name: bivariate_poisson_shared_score_v2
candidate.marginal_intensities: identical fixture-level home/away marginal means as the frozen baseline
candidate.generative_form: Home=A+C; Away=B+C; A~Poisson(mu_home-kappa), B~Poisson(mu_away-kappa), C~Poisson(kappa), mutually independent.
candidate.theta_estimation: Expanding-history maximum likelihood using prior completed matches only; one league-level theta, refit only after complete prior calendar dates.
candidate.regularization: Fixed L2 penalty 8.0 on theta in unconstrained logit space; no hyperparameter search.
candidate.fallback: If optimizer fails or fewer than 100 prior matches are available, theta=0 and candidate equals the independent baseline joint structure.
candidate.score_matrix: Analytic bivariate-Poisson probability matrix, aggregated to 0..6/7+ home-away buckets; no Monte Carlo.
candidate.normalization: Probability conservation must be within 1e-10 after tail aggregation.

primary_metric.name: bucketed_exact_score_log_score
primary_metric.delta_definition: candidate minus baseline; negative is better

development_gate.reason_scientific_component_pass_disallo: Development evidence is retrospective and no independent confirmation or provable historical PIT has yet been opened/completed.

before_test_labels: Freeze bivariate Poisson PMF and tail aggregation
implementation_freeze_policy.coverage_preflight_before_full_implement: Match metadata may be opened only after this preregistration exists; because metadata contains final scores, once opened the development panel is conservatively marked VIEWED and can never become an independent confirmation panel.

post_result_policy.if_fail: Freeze result; do not retune on the NWSL development test; do not open reserved confirmation panel.
post_result_policy.if_pass: Freeze result; remain research-only; do not automatically open reserved confirmation, B05, protected labels, Ready/merge, promotion, CURRENT, or formal_weight.
